en: 7. Anusaya-Yamaka 7.2 Mahāvāra 7.2.8.
Dhātu-visajjanāvāra (The Section on the Refutation of the Elements)

For one who passes away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is reborn in the sense-sphere realm, seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, and five underlying tendencies underlie in other cases;

there are no categories of underlying tendencies [where fewer than five underlie]. For one who passes away from the sense-sphere realm and is reborn in the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in other cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in yet others.

They underlie; there is no classification of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is being reborn in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*), for some seven underlying tendencies underlie, for some five underlying tendencies underlie, and for some three underlying tendencies underlie;
there is no classification of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is being reborn not in the sense-sphere realm, seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no breakdowns of the underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm and is being reborn not in the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases...
In some cases five underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some cases three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmadhātu) and is being reborn in the formless realm (arūpadhātu), in some cases seven underlying tendencies underlie;
in some cases five underlying tendencies underlie; in some cases three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is being reborn neither in the sense-sphere realm nor in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no breakdowns of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm and is being reborn neither in the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*) nor in the formless realm... [the same applies].
Seven underlying tendencies underlie [in some]; for some, five underlying tendencies underlie; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is reborn neither in the sense-sphere realm nor in the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*), for some seven underlying tendencies underlie, for some five underlying tendencies underlie, and for some three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies. (Based on the sense-sphere realm.)

For one who passes away from the fine-material element (*rūpadhātu*) and is reborn in the fine-material element, seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who passes away from the fine-material element and is reborn in the sense-sphere element (*kāmadhātu*), exactly seven underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who passes away from the form realm (*rūpadhātu*) and is reborn in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no breakdowns of the underlying tendencies.
For one who passes away from the form realm and is not reborn in the sense realm (*kāmadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases.
In some, five underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.
For one who passes away from the fine-material element (rūpadhātu) and is reborn in the fine-material element, in some seven underlying tendencies underlie;
in some five underlying tendencies underlie; in some three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who passes away from the form realm (*rūpadhātu*) and is reborn not in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no breakdowns (*bhaṅga*) of underlying tendencies.
For one who passes away from the form realm and is reborn neither in the sense realm (*kāmadhātu*) nor in the formless realm, seven underlying tendencies...
In some cases five underlying tendencies (anusaya) persist; in some cases three underlying tendencies persist; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the fine-material element (rūpadhātu) and is reborn neither in the fine-material element nor in the immaterial element (arūpadhātu), exactly seven underlying tendencies persist;

there are no permutations of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away from the fine-material element and is reborn neither in the sense-sphere element (kāmadhātu) nor in the fine-material element...

For one being reborn [in the fine-material sphere], in some cases seven underlying tendencies underlie, in some cases five underlying tendencies underlie, and in some cases three underlying tendencies underlie;
there are no permutations of underlying tendencies. (Based on the fine-material element.
For one passing away from the immaterial element and being reborn in the immaterial element, in some cases seven underlying tendencies underlie... [and so forth].
Five underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie [in some]; for some, three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the formless realm (arūpadhātu) and is being reborn into the sense realm (kāmadhātu), exactly five underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.
There is no such thing as being reborn into the fine-material realm (rūpadhātu) after passing away from the formless realm; if one is being reborn below, it is only into the sense realm.
When one is reborn, seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; there is no classification of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn in the sense realm, for some seven underlying tendencies underlie, for some five underlying tendencies underlie, and for some three underlying tendencies underlie; there is no classification of underlying tendencies.

For one who passes away from the formless realm and is reborn not in the form realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.
For one who passes away from the formless realm and is reborn not in the formless realm, exactly seven underlying tendencies underlie; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*), there is no rebirth in either the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) or the formless realm. When reborn below, one is reborn only in the sense-sphere realm;
seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) persist, and there are no classifications of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn neither in the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*) nor the formless realm, there are seven [underlying tendencies that persist].

Latent dispositions underlie; there is no analysis of latent dispositions. For one who has passed away from the formless element and is being reborn neither in the sense element nor in the fine-material element, for some seven latent dispositions underlie, for some five latent dispositions underlie, and for some three latent dispositions underlie;
there is no analysis of latent dispositions. (Based on the formless element.)

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmadhātu) and is being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, exactly seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm and is being reborn in the fine-material realm (rūpadhātu), in some cases seven underlying tendencies underlie, in some cases five underlying tendencies underlie, and in some cases three underlying tendencies underlie; [as for] the underlying tendencies...

There is no breakage [of the seven underlying tendencies]. For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is being reborn in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*), for some seven underlying tendencies persist, for some five underlying tendencies persist, and for some three underlying tendencies persist; there is no breakage of the underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm and is not being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for some seven underlying tendencies persist...
In some, five underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who passes away from the sense-sphere realm (kāmadhātu) and is reborn in the fine-material realm (rūpadhātu), in some seven underlying tendencies underlie, in some five underlying tendencies underlie, and in some three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is being reborn not in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm and is being reborn neither in the sense-sphere realm nor in the formless realm, seven...
Latent dispositions underlie: for some, five latent dispositions underlie; for some, three latent dispositions underlie; there is no division regarding latent dispositions.

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and is being reborn neither in the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*) nor in the immaterial realm (*arūpadhātu*), exactly seven latent dispositions underlie;
there is no division regarding latent dispositions. For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm and is being reborn not in the sense-sphere realm...

For one being reborn in the form realm (*rūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases;
there are no combinations of underlying tendencies. (End of the section based on the desire realm.
For one passing away from the form realm and being reborn in the desire realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases...

In some, five underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; there is no classification of underlying tendencies [in this case]. For one who has passed away from the form realm (*rūpadhātu*) and is being reborn in the form realm, in some seven underlying tendencies underlie, in some five underlying tendencies underlie, and in some three underlying tendencies underlie;
there is no classification of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away from the form realm and [is being reborn] in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*)...
For one being reborn, in some cases seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some cases five underlying tendencies underlie;
in some cases three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the form realm and is being reborn in the sense realm, in some cases seven underlying tendencies underlie.
In some, five underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.
For one who has died in the form realm and is being reborn in the form realm, in some seven underlying tendencies underlie;
in some five underlying tendencies underlie; in some three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has died in the form realm and is being reborn not in the formless realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no categories of underlying tendencies [in this case].
For one who has died in the form realm and is being reborn neither in the sense realm nor in the formless realm, seven...
Latent dispositions underlie: for some, five latent dispositions underlie; for some, three latent dispositions underlie; there are no permutations of latent dispositions.
For one who has passed away from the form realm and is being reborn neither in the form realm nor in the formless realm, for some seven latent dispositions underlie;
for some, five latent dispositions underlie; there are no permutations of latent dispositions.

For one who has passed away from the form realm (*rūpadhātu*) and is being reborn neither in the sense realm (*kāmadhātu*) nor in the form realm, seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no classifications of underlying tendencies.
(The section based on the non-form realm.)
For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn in the sense realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and five underlying tendencies underlie in other cases;

there are no classifications of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn in the fine-material realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in other cases, and [three underlying tendencies underlie] in other cases.

Three underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; there is no breaking up of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away from the formless realm (arūpadhātu) and is being reborn in the formless realm, for some seven underlying tendencies underlie, for some five underlying tendencies underlie, and for some three underlying tendencies underlie;
there is no breaking up of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn in the sense realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no breakdowns of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn in the fine-material realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases.
In some, five underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn in the formless realm, in some seven underlying tendencies underlie;
in some, five underlying tendencies underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn neither in the sense realm nor in the formless realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no breakdowns of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn neither in the fine-material realm nor in the formless realm...
In some, seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, five underlying tendencies underlie; there is no classification of underlying tendencies [in this case].

For one who has passed away from the formless realm and is being reborn neither in the sense realm nor in the form realm, in some seven underlying tendencies underlie, in some five underlying tendencies underlie, and in some three underlying tendencies underlie.
There is no analysis of underlying tendencies (*anusaya*). (End of the section based on the formless realm.

For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) nor from the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*) and is being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, exactly seven underlying tendencies underlie;

there is no analysis of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor from the formless realm and is [being reborn] in the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*)...
For one being reborn, in some cases seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie, in some cases five underlying tendencies underlie, and in some cases three underlying tendencies underlie;

there are no permutations of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor from the formless realm and is being reborn in the formless realm, in some cases seven underlying tendencies underlie, and in some cases five underlying tendencies [underlie].
They underlie: for some, three underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has died neither in the sense-sphere realm nor in the formless realm and is being reborn in the sense-sphere realm, for some seven underlying tendencies underlie, for some five underlying tendencies underlie, and for some three underlying tendencies underlie.

There is no analysis of underlying tendencies (*anusaya*). For one who has died neither in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) nor in the formless realm (*arūpadhātu*) and is being reborn in the form realm (*rūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases;
there is no analysis of underlying tendencies. For one who has died neither in the sense-sphere realm nor in the formless realm and is being reborn in the formless realm...
For one being reborn, in some cases seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some cases five underlying tendencies underlie;
in some cases three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor from the formless realm, and is being reborn neither in the sense-sphere realm nor in the formless realm—
In some, seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, five underlying tendencies underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie;

there is no variation in the underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm (kāmadhātu) nor the formless-sphere realm (arūpadhātu) and is reborn neither in the form-sphere realm (rūpadhātu) nor the formless-sphere realm, exactly seven underlying tendencies underlie; there is no variation in the underlying tendencies. Not...

For one who has passed away from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) and not the formless-sphere realm (*arūpadhātu*), and is being reborn neither in the sense-sphere realm nor the form-sphere realm:
for some, seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie; for some, five underlying tendencies underlie; for some, three underlying tendencies underlie.
There are no combinations of underlying tendencies. (Based on the root of "neither sense-sphere nor formless-sphere.")

For one who has passed away from neither the form realm nor the formless realm and is being reborn in the sense realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and five underlying tendencies underlie in other cases; there are no breakdowns of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away from neither the form realm nor the formless realm and is being reborn in the form realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases... [and so on].
Five underlying tendencies underlie [in some]; for some, three underlying tendencies underlie; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away neither from the fine-material element nor the immaterial element and is being reborn in the immaterial element, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away neither from the form realm nor the formless realm and is being reborn in the sense realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away neither from the form realm nor the formless realm and is being reborn in the form realm...
In some, seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, five underlying tendencies underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie;

there is no classification of underlying tendencies [in this case]. For one who has passed away neither from the form realm nor the formless realm and is being reborn into the formless realm, in some, seven underlying tendencies underlie; in some, five underlying tendencies underlie; in some...
Three underlying tendencies underlie; there is no classification of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away neither from the fine-material element nor from the immaterial element and is being reborn neither in the sense-sphere element nor in the immaterial element, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases.

They underlie; there is no classification of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away neither from the fine-material element nor from the immaterial element and is being reborn neither in the fine-material element nor in the immaterial element, for some seven underlying tendencies underlie, and for some five underlying tendencies underlie;

there is no classification of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away neither from the fine-material element nor from the immaterial element [and is being reborn] not in the sense-sphere element...

For one being reborn in the form realm (*rūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no combinations of underlying tendencies. (End of the section based on neither the form realm nor the formless realm.
For one passing away from neither the sense realm (*kāmadhātu*) nor the form realm and being reborn in the sense realm, exactly seven underlying tendencies underlie.

There is no destruction of underlying tendencies (*anusaya*). For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*) nor the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*), there is no such thing as rebirth in the fine-material realm;
if reborn below, one is reborn only in the sense-sphere realm, and exactly seven underlying tendencies underlie [the mind];

there is no destruction of underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor the fine-material realm and is being reborn in the immaterial realm (*arūpadhātu*)...
In some, seven underlying tendencies (anusaya) underlie; in some, five underlying tendencies underlie; in some, three underlying tendencies underlie;
there is no division regarding the underlying tendencies.
For one who has died neither in the sense-sphere realm (kāmadhātu) nor in the fine-material realm (rūpadhātu) and is being reborn not in the sense-sphere realm, in some, seven...
Latent dispositions underlie: for some, five latent dispositions underlie; for some, three latent dispositions underlie;

there are no categories of underlying dispositions. For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor the fine-material realm and is being reborn in the fine-material realm, for some seven latent dispositions underlie, for some five latent dispositions underlie, and for some three latent dispositions underlie.

The underlying tendencies persist; there is no cessation of the underlying tendencies. For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor the fine-material realm and is being reborn not in the formless realm, exactly five underlying tendencies persist; there is no cessation of the underlying tendencies.
For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor the fine-material realm, there is no such thing as being reborn neither in the sense-sphere realm nor the formless realm.

There is none. One being reborn from the lower realms is reborn only in the sense-sphere realm (*kāmadhātu*); seven underlying tendencies (*anusaya*) underlie [the mind], and there are no permutations of underlying tendencies.

For one who has passed away neither from the sense-sphere realm nor the fine-material realm (*rūpadhātu*) and is being reborn neither in the fine-material realm nor the immaterial realm (*arūpadhātu*), seven underlying tendencies underlie [the mind], and there are no permutations of underlying tendencies. Neither from the sense-sphere realm nor...

For one who has passed away from the form realm and is being reborn neither in the sense realm nor in the form realm, seven underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, five underlying tendencies underlie in some cases, and three underlying tendencies underlie in some cases; there are no divisions of underlying tendencies.
(Based on the non-sense-realm and non-form-realm.)
The Section on the Analysis of Elements.
The Manual of the Pairs on Latent Dispositions is finished.
